To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we present a novel approach to multi person pose tracking that relies on a temporal flow fields to predict the motion of joints.

• We propose a novel representation of temporal flow fields to model the temporal dynamics of body joints • We show that this representation is able to capture the temporal information of human poses • Our temporal network can be trained end to end with a small CNN network • Our method achieves state of the art tracking performance in the MPII Human Pose dataset.
